article.hook: Someone shifts the conversation mid-sentence. You notice the quick pivot, the spark chasing a new idea. That’s the Sun in Gemini pulling focus for a few weeks.
article.lived: For about a month, the spotlight presses on questions, connections, and the dance of language. We swap stories in rapid-fire bursts, trading thoughts like currency and leaping from one thread to the next. New details grab our attention faster than we can close the last tab, and conversations feel electric but unfinished.
article.turn: What starts as curiosity can turn into scatter - chasing every new lead but never landing on one. We trade depth for speed, losing track of what we meant to say or decide. If you wander past the point of choice, you leave the story half-told and the moment wasted.
